Package org.jdesktop.lg3d.displayserver.desktop2d

Class Desktop2DMenuConfig

java.lang.Object
org.jdesktop.lg3d.displayserver.desktop2d.Desktop2DMenuConfig
public final class Desktop2DMenuConfig extends Object
Reads the .lgcfg application descriptors the 3D start menu is built from, without instantiating any of the beans they describe.

The descriptors are java.beans.XMLEncoder documents; decoding them the way DefaultConfigControl does would construct the scene-manager classes named in the file (Java 3D included), which is exactly what a machine without 3D cannot do. This reader therefore parses them as plain XML and keeps only the two bean kinds the menu needs - StartMenuGroupConfig and StartMenuItemConfig - as inert Desktop2DMenuConfig.GroupSpec / Desktop2DMenuConfig.ItemSpec values. The 2D desktop consequently shows the same applications, in the same groups, in the same order as the 3D start menu.

Scanned locations mirror the display server's own discovery: every *.lgcfg under ${lg.etcdir}/lg3d, plus the config/demo and config/incubator directories on the classpath (where the lg3d-apps and lg3d-incubator jars bundle their descriptors).
